podcast.body: Featured on Tune-Yards' 2011 album "w h o k i l l," this song has gained broader exposure through its inclusion in episodes of popular television shows such as "The Good Wife," "Orange Is the New Black," and "Weeds." It is highlighted as an example of Tune-Yards' wonderfully distinctive music. "You may have heard this song as part of an episode of The Good Wife, or Orange is the New Black or Weeds. It's called Gangsta."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
